findings: Solved 2026-10-30 on the owner's request (exercises book by book, in Practice): Chapter 22 (Hydroxy Compounds) exercise as printed on PDF 98-100 (printed pages 95-97), in the book's words and order.

Q2(e): A and D both give a single alkene (2-methylpropene); A is given as the answer, D noted. Q2(c)(i) stage 2 reagent (aqueous NaOH) is not printed in the question.
